description: Capability for sandboxed mesh-app webviews (windows labelled `meshapp-*`). Grants the minimal core surface needed to run a webview and reach the host over IPC (so `window.meshApp` works), but deliberately NOT shell / dialog / fs / updater — those plugin permissions stay scoped to the main window in default.json. NOTE: Tauri v2 does not gate app commands per-window (tauri#9227), so this capability cannot restrict WHICH app commands a meshapp window may invoke. That restriction is `crate::meshapp::bridge_refusal`, consulted in the one invoke closure in `main.rs` before any command runs: a `meshapp-*` window may invoke only the eighteen names in `MESHAPP_BRIDGE_COMMANDS`, which are exactly the commands `meshapp_shim.js` puts on `window.meshApp`. Beneath it, `crate::meshapp::authorize` is still the per-command install-grant gate, and the per-window CSP still blocks egress.
